lanes.name: Host/World identity and authority
lanes.objective: Trace ARBOR Host World state, actual durable writer, permissions, control catalog, plan/journal/receipt functions and missing World migration seams.

lanes.name: Studio/Chrome provider seam
lanes.objective: Trace Studio Chrome owner, accepted read sessions, learned read-only adapter factory, hand-written sender, registered AI profiles and exact thread binding.

lanes.name: Rust personal graph seam
lanes.objective: Trace native/hqkg scoped_graph, typed_dag and existing Rust/Host bridge; distinguish structural graph validation from Host authentication.

lanes.name: PWA/TierFlow seam
lanes.objective: Trace existing PWA single entrypoint, phone Host transport, TierFlow UI publisher/revision guards and Studio screen extension points.

lanes.name: Top-ten feasibility atlas
lanes.objective: Study ten named services, separate export/read/write, account and platform restrictions, evidence and provider terms. No assertions of live support.

lanes.name: Negative acceptance and duplication
lanes.objective: Compare Labs R001 schema to ARBOR actual types; propose narrow reusable ports, negative tests and no-second-World/dispatcher rules.

lanes.name: Schemas and validators
lanes.objective: Create versioned descriptor/account/stream/content/action/receipt projection schemas, runtime validators, sample golden fixtures and strict unknown-value refusals.

lanes.name: Hub registry and service
lanes.objective: Build one injected-port ProviderHub supporting list providers/streams/read thread/search/propose action/status, capability gating and bounded paging.

lanes.name: Fake future World port
lanes.objective: Implement typed fake World grants/evidence/commit receipts and an interface ready for later existing Host World; never create durable competing World.

lanes.name: Fake Host action boundary
lanes.objective: Implement inert action-plan/readback/approval and mock receipt adapter. No direct send; later live actions must use existing Host dispatcher.

lanes.name: Mock Rust graph interface
lanes.objective: Build source/ref graph proposal adapter and deterministic fake that obeys personal namespace, CAS revisions, provenance; no graph store.

lanes.name: Seeded source simulators
lanes.objective: Create deterministic fake StudioSourcePort and seeded 10-provider-safe synthetic data, fault scripts, clock, receipt markers and no live network.

lanes.name: Identity and source binding
lanes.objective: Implement provider/product/account/session/thread/recipient identity model, freshness/epoch and account-swap invalidation; URL does not establish identity.

lanes.name: Normalized stream processing
lanes.objective: Implement source-qualified units, dedup, bounded cursors, deltas, partial/stale/denied states, resumable import against fake World receipts.

lanes.name: Inbox/feed/media read models
lanes.objective: Create source-backed inbox, timeline, media and search models with provenance/freshness and missing-data states, no unapproved model inferred content.

lanes.name: Studio UI
lanes.objective: Add source explorer/consent plan/read-model panels to existing Studio through mock Host route; do not create new Studio app.

lanes.name: Existing PWA UI
lanes.objective: Add provider tabs, inbox/feeds/thread viewer and local draft preview to existing PWA; no direct provider effect and no second phone app.

lanes.name: Observability and job state
lanes.objective: Build bounded mock source sync/import/pause/revoke/repair status and sanitized metrics through existing Host concept, no new durable ledger.

lanes.name: Facebook pack
lanes.objective: Mock Facebook posts/comments/reactions/groups/media, official export and scoped read routes, denied/partial cases; messages live in Messenger pack.

lanes.name: Messenger pack
lanes.objective: Mock facebook.com/messages thread list/read, participants, attachments, exact target/draft, E2EE gaps, send-once approval and uncertain receipts.

lanes.name: Instagram pack
lanes.objective: Mock feed/stories/reels/media/comments/DMs with account distinctions, ephemeral states and read/write capability refusals.

lanes.name: WhatsApp pack
lanes.objective: Mock linked device session, groups/messages/media/export and offline/E2EE/unlinked states; no covert pairing, API or cookie transfer.

lanes.name: Cross-Meta UI journeys
lanes.objective: Compose Facebook→Messenger→Instagram→WhatsApp navigation with provider-specific consent, provenance, read and composer review mock.

lanes.name: Meta adversarial suite
lanes.objective: Test wrong account/thread, revoked consent, blocked recipient, E2EE gaps, changed draft, duplicate action and uncertain send in all Meta flows.

lanes.name: X pack
lanes.objective: Mock X feed/replies/bookmarks/DMs, restrictions and stale/locked account states.

lanes.name: YouTube pack
lanes.objective: Mock YouTube watch history/subscriptions/playlists/channels/comments, unavailable media and pagination.

lanes.name: Reddit pack
lanes.objective: Mock Reddit posts/subreddits/replies/saves/inbox and read-only/reply-proposal statuses.

lanes.name: LinkedIn pack
lanes.objective: Mock LinkedIn feed/connections/messages/comments and strict unsupported automation states.

lanes.name: Telegram pack
lanes.objective: Mock Telegram chats/channels/groups/media, linked web and secret/unavailable conversation limits.

lanes.name: Gmail pack
lanes.objective: Mock Gmail threads/messages/labels/drafts/attachments, separate account permissions and provider-specific submission uncertainty.

lanes.name: Unified inbox
lanes.objective: Cross-provider inbox and search filters, thread detail and native identity separation; one read projection, no provider auto-send.

lanes.name: Unified feed and media
lanes.objective: Cross-provider feed, media, source anchors, save/search and explicit capability-driven provider-specific actions.

lanes.name: Composer and approval
lanes.objective: Unify local draft/recipient/attachment confirmation, approval intent, mock Host claim and verified-or-uncertain receipt; block unsupported actions.

lanes.name: Natural language intents
lanes.objective: Parse 'message Alex on Messenger', 'show my Reddit saves' into typed read or inert Host plan, no model-granted permissions.

lanes.name: Phone parity
lanes.objective: Compose full PWA provider experience; offline draft and reconnect without replay; access revocation and responsive UI.

lanes.name: Personal graph/knowledge
lanes.objective: Synthetic source evidence→existing personal-scoped Rust graph proposal port→source-backed search and DCB preview, cross-owner refusal.

lanes.name: Recovery and replay
lanes.objective: Crash/restart, exact event replay, import idempotency, journal uncertainty and never-retry-send proof.

lanes.name: Security and privacy
lanes.objective: Wrong principal/account/recipient, malicious source text, grant revocation, unknown provider origin, cross-owner graph and data leakage.

lanes.name: Ten-provider parity
lanes.objective: 10/10 pack contract tests, 20+ scenarios, unsupported feature truth, schema golden-compatibility and consumer coverage.

lanes.name: Performance
lanes.objective: Synthetic 10k thread/100k unit budgets, pagination/backpressure/memory low-disk faults; report actual hardware and measurements.

lanes.name: ARBOR package closure
lanes.objective: Self-contained Bun/Cargo/Host/PWA mock setup and tests without donor repo/runtime or live account credentials.

lanes.name: Independent audit
lanes.objective: Inspect every lane, source/fixture proof, status ledger, runtime gaps, Windows/phone/live account UNRUN and minimum safe later live handoff.
